name: ChatAnywhere
description: ChatAnywhere provides a free API key for non-commercial use.
overview: ChatAnywhere describes a free OpenAI-compatible relay key with 50,000 points per week and 100 requests per day per key. Registration and GitHub binding are required. Its free tier supports GPT-4o and GPT-5 series and DeepSeek, but is restricted to personal, educational and nonprofit research use; commercial use is prohibited. Points are not equivalent to tokens.
free_access: Personal, educational and nonprofit research only
notes: Verify the current free-key model list and region restrictions in the dashboard. Card requirement is not specified.
